title: Tensor-Lifted Multivariate Functional Calculus Beyond Commutativity and Boundedness
summary: Classical functional calculus is primarily spectral, capturing eigenvalue information through resolvent methods while largely ignoring nilpotent structure. Building on the projector-nilpotent characterization developed in our companion work, we introduce a multivariate functional calculus for arbitrary operators that incorporates both spectral and algebraic information. The framework has three main components.
